Home.headline: One system for the whole job.
Home.subhead: Garages run on trust — and on a lot of retyping. Motivox removes the retyping and makes the trust visible: a signed quote, photos on every line, a status the customer can check themselves.
Home.bayTitle: Jobs the way the shop runs — digital.
Home.baySub: Plate, work, and status at a glance. No whiteboard. No sticky notes.
Home.step1Body: Customer and vehicle stay on the same file. Your checklists, status per item, licence-plate lookup via RDW (including APK date). Findings feed the quote — no second inventory.
Home.step2Body: Work plan from the inspection plus your services library. Printable PDF in the shop, or a secure link with signature and timestamp. Then the customer picks a slot.
Home.step3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Timer or manual hours, parts and consumables. Invoice from the same rules — pro forma or final.
Home.portalBody: Customers sign the quote, then pick an appointment slot (no cold self-booking), follow the repair, and download the invoice. Online pay if you connected Mollie or Tikkie.
Home.portalImageAlt: Technician working in a garage workshop
Home.heroImageAlt: Dutch auto repair shop floor — context for Motivox garage software
Home.ctaImageAlt: Tools and workshop environment at an auto repair shop
Home.rolesSub: Everyone works in one system — with exactly the tools their role needs.
Home.roleBackBody: Customers, inspection, quotes, planning, hour approval, and invoicing — no Excel islands.
Home.roleTechBody: Own web portal: dashboard and schedule, work order, inspection on the floor, timer or manual hours, photos and video on the line.
Home.roleCustBody: Sign the quote, pick a slot after approval, follow status, download the invoice — with a one-time code or a secure link. No password to forget in the waiting room.
Home.faq1A: Motivox is Dutch-first garage workshop software (SaaS) by Innovolabs B.V. One system for intake, inspection, approval, shop-floor work, hours, parts, and invoice — without retyping.
Home.faq2A: Yes. 30 days, and it is the full Garage version — live shop planning included. No mandatory demo call; you start yourself via onboarding.
Home.faq3A: Three web portals on one source of truth: back office, technician, and customer. There is no separate native iOS or Android app.
Home.faq4A: ZZP €35 or Garage €80 per month excl. VAT. Extra seats (Garage) €4 per month. Billing via Stripe with a Dutch VAT invoice.
Home.faq5Q: How do VAT and payments work?
Home.faq5A: Your Motivox subscription runs through Stripe (iDEAL, SEPA, or card); Stripe Tax adds VAT. Customers can pay online if you connect Mollie or Tikkie.
Home.finalCtaTitle: Less retyping. More time under the bonnet.
Home.finalCtaBody: Sign up. You get a trial, then onboarding with company details, rates, and logo.
Home.faq6Q: I work alone. Is this overkill?
Home.faq6A: No — that is what ZZP (€35) is for. One account switches between office and workshop, you get planned as a technician yourself, and you count once towards your plan.
Home.pulseTitle: Know how the day is going before the coffee is cold.
Home.pulseBody: Your dashboard, your tiles. Drag them, resize them, keep only what you actually look at — low stock, each technician’s workload, what needs action today.
Home.liveTitle: Monday morning, without the phone tree.
Home.liveBody: Arrivals, night-drop cars, replanned appointments and real shop capacity on one board — plus a team cockpit that shows who is clocked on and what they have on.

Features.title: Everything the shop needs
Features.intro: Office, technician, and customer portal — one chain from intake to invoice, and a dashboard that tells you how the day is going.
Features.storyTitle: The Golf is outside. Brakes squeal.
Features.storyIntro: The real flow: inspection → quote → approval → floor → invoice. Customer, car, and job stay the same chain.
Features.beat1Body: Your own inspection checklists: sections, items, order. Per item OK, attention, urgent, or n/a plus a note. Save as draft, finalize, then read-only. Findings carry into the quote.
Features.beat2Title: A quote the customer can trust.
Features.beat2Body: A work plan with multiple lines, built from the inspection and your services library. Printable PDF for an in-shop signature, or a secure link with signature and timestamp — by email.
Features.beat3Body: Work order from the approved plan. Assign and schedule technicians. The customer picks a slot from the same shop capacity. Timer (one running) or manual hours, photos and video on the line.
Features.beat4Body: Approve or reject hours (with a reason). Then a pro forma or final invoice from hours, parts, and consumables. PDF download via a secure link — no attachment by default.

Pricing.title: Two plans. Thirty days to find out if you’d miss it.
Pricing.intro: Your trial is the full Garage version, live shop planning included. After 30 days, pick ZZP or Garage — monthly via Stripe, prices excl. VAT.
Pricing.trialNote: No required demo call. A second shop: its own registration + wizard.
Pricing.zzpTagline: For the one-person shop — and maybe one helper.
Pricing.garageTagline: For teams that run intake to invoice together.
Pricing.extraSeats: Need more accounts on Garage? Extra seats are €4 per month excl. VAT per account. On ZZP, the upgrade is the answer.
Pricing.finePrint: Prices excl. VAT. Activate your subscription in Motivox via Stripe. Garage group (unlimited seats) on request.
Pricing.enterpriseLink: Garage group or onboarding questions? Contact us →
Pricing.included1Body: New features without separate upgrade fees.
Pricing.included2Body: Email support on business days, NL/EN.
Pricing.included3Body: Secure cloud hosting and backups. Each shop sees only its own data.
Pricing.included4Body: Office vs technician, plus multi-factor authentication for staff.
Pricing.faq1A: Sign up. After email confirmation you go through onboarding. You get a 30-day trial; then activate ZZP or Garage under Settings → Subscription.
Pricing.faq2A: Monthly via Stripe (iDEAL, SEPA, or card). Prices are excl. VAT; Stripe Tax adds VAT. You get a Dutch VAT invoice.
Pricing.faq3A: No — cancel monthly via the Stripe customer portal in Motivox.
Pricing.faq4A: Yes, when your shop has connected Mollie or Tikkie. That is separate from your Motivox subscription.
Pricing.zzpFeatSolo: Solo mode: one login for office and workshop
Pricing.garageFeatPlanning: Live shop planning: arrivals, night-drop, capacity, team cockpit
Pricing.valueTitle: The cheapest hour is the one you forgot to bill.
Pricing.valueBody: If your hourly rate is above €35, a single forgotten hour pays for a month of ZZP. That is the job of this software: not to be clever, but to stop money leaking out of the gaps between your tools.
Pricing.value1: Hours are approved, then invoiced — not remembered on Friday.
Pricing.value2: Consumables are added by rule (default 8% of labour), not by feel.
Pricing.value3: APK reminders bring customers back without anyone picking up the phone.
Pricing.faq5Q: What do I get during the trial?
Pricing.faq5A: The full Garage version for 30 days, live shop planning included. Afterwards you choose ZZP or Garage; live shop planning is part of Garage.
Pricing.faq6Q: Can I add extra seats on ZZP?
Pricing.faq6A: ZZP includes you plus one extra account (office or technician). Need more people? Upgrade to Garage — extra seats at €4 per month are available there.

About.title: Built for Dutch repair shops
About.intro: Motivox is a product of Innovolabs B.V. — made to replace Excel/Access workflows without disrupting the floor.
About.storyBody: One chain: customer → car → inspection → quote → work order → hours → parts → invoice. Built for Dutch garages: VAT, KvK, APK reminders, consumables. Dutch first, English available. Your shop, your data. Three web portals — office, technician, and customer — not a separate native mobile app.
About.value1: Dutch-first — UI and processes for the local market, including invoice identity.
About.value2: One source of truth — inspection through invoice linked, without retyping.
About.value3: Customer transparency — approve, book, track, pay, without internal notes.
